items.followUp: Differentiate between saturated and unsaturated fatty acids.

rubric.why: Saturated fatty acids have no double bonds between their carbon atoms.
rubric.description: States that saturated fatty acids have no carbon–carbon double bonds.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that saturated fatty acids have no double bonds, or have only single bonds, between carbon atoms.

rubric.why: Unsaturated fatty acids have one or more double bonds between their carbon atoms.
rubric.description: States that unsaturated fatty acids have one or more carbon–carbon double bonds.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that unsaturated fatty acids have one or more double bonds between carbon atoms.

modelAnswer: Saturated fatty acids have no double bonds between their carbon atoms.
Unsaturated fatty acids have one or more double bonds between their carbon atoms.
